Fed up with weak leaders
I understand hardship because I've lived it. I understand leadership because I've practiced it in war zones, on rescue missions, and while rebuilding broken communities.

| | | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=b0ef0e2718db45d4ae723573028dd139&_e=yg1hw1giZtOnHuq1xqgLBLf8JvG7eGgEiUca8VIY0MfKv0Mjb_kQwwL2_pEVCu7R4OmSn3tsOSzlvLbITgUFp0e6vdXwlHdvZ_EfLWc4UO1WkNd1ZxWbaG75Qhkg4rSWen57gOUa_alVWW0mdR9Tr62awTBaHnNutE97936b1P1pdReB-auL3WPXTxsCP4q8TObsigW8aseTeAPVmmQ-Kto26vkOlxgaFPkSwyiT9dxt5wQzKdA_psFbzXgQOvXzLYYplC15W2sR0i3ZLbuSLl0juSff3VQaQ3txsfPjU33accGY9NCvUgjmW8Uk3c_WVoE2Vwiw2_2hVAZOnwu2KY_XjZtpOVu03GOvVP_VpfIDUmZWxoeQribbdrJhe7Xbu-OkyWrLDzTZEKJZ7tr7hoVaajt71k31doH1dZkJzIo7fdPFbsAu9K9CY1IaVXDku5JIkb_LCD6LuyMiS8f_vSI0VILa1qup3oULe5TRigG6epBzWUByni92EXZy-WxcAkGMmr0Etdtf8sF8hX2vTCMB4A7dxTLrKnDAEjY7hZTm6gHz8KV0Qzcke4rJEprEqWaXmUVgvWZLLP-zfZmKnBuMDYYo4CaeifNwobWV71dXJCjaDJpWMLY3KnXT_o_w_I-6bJTNOs_hWirRN472ww%3D%3D)
---
| | Friend,
---
My name is Victor Marx, and I'm the leading Republican candidate in the race for Governor of Colorado. Our state is at a crossroads, much like our nation was in 2024, and it's created an opportunity here that **_we can't afford to miss._** **But before I get into that** , let me tell you more about me, why I'm running, and why I need your support. My life is living proof that **no hardship is too great to overcome.** By the time I was 17 years old, I had lived in 17 homes and attended 14 schools. Every statistic said my story should have ended _very _differently. **But God had other plans for my life.** Joining the United States Marine Corps became one of the most profound decisions I ever made. The Marines taught me discipline, brotherhood, and, for the first time, gave me a true sense of purpose. Through faith and service, I learned how to turn trauma into mission. I** committed my life to rescuing and restoring others from the same darkness I once walked through.** _That commitment has defined everything I've done since._ Through my ministry, **I 've led more than 150 high-risk missions into some of the most dangerous regions on earth, **delivering trauma relief, medical aid, and hope to victims of terrorism, trafficking, and violence. **Our teams have served more than 45,000 women and children, many rescued from captivity and given a second chance at life.** Those missions require calm under pressure, moral clarity, and leadership when the cost is real. Failure isn't theoretical in those environments. _Lives are on the line._ Along the way, I've been blessed to know men of deep conviction and courage; leaders who don't just talk about change but live it. One of those men was my dear friend, the late **Charlie Kirk.** I first met Charlie while speaking at a small, predominantly Latino church in Oxnard, California. I spoke before him that morning, even though he had been scheduled as the keynote. Later, he told me he had been frustrated, until he heard the message. He said it deeply impacted him. We connected afterward (helped along by my dog, Scout), stayed in touch, and over time I spoke at multiple Turning Point and Turning Point Faith events, often alongside my bride, Eileen. I still keep the first photo from that morning as a reminder that God weaves every encounter into His greater plan. **Today, I'm stepping into a new mission, ****_right here at home._** I understand hardship because I've lived it. I understand leadership because I've practiced it in war zones, on rescue missions, and while rebuilding broken communities. Crime is rising. Families are struggling. Faith and freedom are under attack. # [Tell Kristi Noem: Apologize for Calling Murdered Americans Domestic Terrorists](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfd28a1bc-6830-4740-8e09-954877137d66/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | When Kristi Noem said Americans murdered by federal agents in Minnesota were domestic terrorists, she was full of crap, and she knew it. There was no evidence of this, and there was no investigation to back the allegation up (by her own admission, it's still underway). She had bupkis. Nada. Nothing. And yet she said it anyway, defaming the victims, and torching their reputations for the whole world to see. And when video after video appeared, showing they were victims, not attackers, she still wouldn't admit she was wrong, or apologize to the grieving families. Even under oath, in front of congress. [**Noem needs to admit she was wrong, admit she had no evidence, and apologize. And then, if she has any decency left at all, she needs to resign.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T657c32d9-53bc-4969-91cc-425fda8da8af/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [**Sign if you agree.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T60ff0a19-5251-4094-a81b-e38eaf5d5bae/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: AOC
subject: We can make a new world.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We don't have to live like this anymore.
#
I grew up in a working-class family.
My mom cleaned houses and my dad worked to build a small business. My parents worked themselves to the bone so that my brother and I could just have a shot.
And for a moment there, it looked like we were going to make it: we had a home, bills were a little less stressful to pay, and I was doing well in school. What may have looked like a modest life to others was a dream come true for us.
But suddenly, when I was a teenager, my dad was diagnosed with a rare form of cancer. He passed away in September of 2008, just as the economy crashed in the Great Recession and millions of jobs across this country vanished.
It felt like the world of our family fell apart as the larger world was falling apart too.
Overnight, my mom was left to figure out how to provide for two kids by herself, put them through school, keep our house, pay off my dad's medical bills — all on a house cleaner salary.
That's how I became a waitress. Because it was millions of innocent working families who paid the price, while the billionaires and thieves who defrauded our financial system got off richer than ever before. **And not a single one of them went to jail**.
And you know what?
**_That_ is the story that Republicans mock — not just mine, but all of ours — when they say a waitress or working person is unqualified to serve in Congress**.
I tell this story not because it is special, but because of how _common_ it is.
While the details may differ, so many of us know what it feels like for life to be one bad day, one bad piece of news, one major setback from everything feeling like it's going to fall apart.
**We don't have to live like this anymore**.
We can make a new world, a better country, where we can fight for the dignity of all people.
And it looks like **living wages**.
It looks like **stable housing**.
It looks like **guaranteed health care**.
And it looks like **respect for all of our differences** , no matter who we are or where we come from.
That means that we must choose to out-organize the oligarchy. We will and must do away with the power of big money.
And that is why, even as a waitress with a long shot campaign, I decided that **I would never take money from lobbyists or corporations — and I never will**.
[Will you make a $5 contribution right now to help us fight for progress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260305.JKjEEN&refcode=em20260305-10903-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10903%2E2526796%2En5m2Jl)
Every donation helps us mobilize, organize, and fight for the working class in the places that need it most.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

I will always stand up for working Pennsylvanians

Derek, I want to share with you what I just shared with hundreds of union workers in Philadelphia last night: **I will ALWAYS stand up for working Pennsylvanians and protect the union way of life in our Commonwealth.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126736392/605788465/-595918774?amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&refcode=email_030526_philly&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTQ2ODFmYy1kMzE4LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RmHenIHqVh9wiDh_4aB-48xdvW3H880pNPv1ivSOfYw=) I believe every hard-working Pennsylvanian deserves a fair wage, good benefits, a safe workplace, and the opportunity to get ahead. That’s what I fought for as Pennsylvania’s Attorney General — prosecuting the largest prevailing wage theft case in history, combating worker misclassification, expanding protections for gig workers, and defending the right to organize. And Derek, that mission hasn’t changed. As Governor, I’m fighting every day to make sure Pennsylvania workers are treated fairly. To rein in bad actors who refuse to follow the law. To ensure Pennsylvania NEVER becomes a right to work state. **To show the extremists in Washington that growing our economy and giving a fair shake to working people go hand-in-hand.** [_**Derek, I’ve always had the back of organized labor and working Pennsylvanians. Trump Fires Noem, Taps Mullin

President Trump announced today that he is replacing Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem with Sen. Markwayne Mullin (R-OK) in the [first major Cabinet shakeup](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkL_uozAQhJ_GdETLYptQuLiGLtdeiRx7CavzH2Q7RPf2J_IGv26k0XzSN38e68Ny4PT6bSMZd_Lqs19becejUQg1ZYr_8rvQxoX8ioC6h7EHtaawDp03zusROzLDNOEklVb3bjezn8FudHcoBzerabLDuLmnewI5Jzfo2FwkGEHhMIDCG3hQWsPdo3oqKQch4X1426jeXE6Vymkbn8Qp5SvldHM5dsHsrR1VjL8ELgKXttPOIVydwGXPkRJ9qsDF-siJayvfrcBFTXqWWvdf077QEayj2v8tXBv3l7XApSvGHx8OgauehIRXtPyFd-3nV50G_wcAAP__fMB5Yg) of his second term. Mullin takes over effective March 31. Noem is being reassigned as "Special Envoy for The Shield of the Americas," a new Western Hemisphere security initiative launching Saturday in Doral, Florida. The move followed a disastrous week of testimony in which Noem told Sen. John Kennedy (R-LA) that Trump approved her [$220 million DHS ad campaign](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkDFyrDAQRE8DmSghkOAHCn5Ctk4dUgINu1OWNJQ0gPf2LnwDZ510V7_3-ZgfDgOm54eLYNcTZ09-5nzEnSGEkgjim44MG2bws5LKCNkJqecU5rb2dvWmUzXYdhjU0Gujx_plFw_gpHHQb-04Lm5xmxnlsLhl6fX2z9Ro7yXZSa3aVmrVSC-1MXL0Si-679uql8fuHUNpVkoF8ukYT8CU6E6UmpViHeyLeS9V979SU6Wm67qajb4TXHctVmraKSDjWio1fWUsjOImEnQUBi-2TFG8KEJwyYsC65GR32KnwsJF9CLDCokFHzkShjpbv18YAhYzVL18Rofh9wj_Xd1p1U8AAAD___sfgiw) — a claim the White House denied. Fox News reported Noem's tenure notched record drug interdictions totaling more than half a million pounds and over 2 million [self-deportations in 2025](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkDFyrDAQRE8DmSghkOAHCn5Ctk4dUgINu1OWNJQ0gPf2LnwDZ510V7_3-ZgfDgOm54eLYNcTZ09-5nzEnSGEkgjim44MG2bws5LKCNkJqecU5rb2dvWmUzXYdhjU0Gujx_plFw_gpHHQb-04Lm5xmxnlsLhl6fX2z9Ro7yXZSa3aVmrVSC-1MXL0Si-679uql8fuHUNpVkoF8ukYT8CU6E6UmpViHeyLeS9V979SU6Wm67qajb4TXHctVmraKSDjWio1fWUsjOImEnQUBi-2TFG8KEJwyYsC65GR32KnwsJF9CLDCokFHzkShjpbv18YAhYzVL18Rofh9wj_Xd1p1U8AAAD___sfgiw), but controversies from Minneapolis to her ad spending proved too much. Mullin, a former MMA fighter and Cherokee Nation citizen, will need [Senate confirmation](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkD3OpDAQRE9jMo-aBhsIHGxCNptuiLx2z0xr_IOMAXH7FXuDLytVSaWn9-e5PC0HTu_fNpJxBy8--6WWPa6VQthSpnjlvdCLC_kFAbWEToJaUljaxhvndYcNmXYYcOiVVmPzMR2g7f00-kkN4JG6VrmpR3IdvsYXTA2b-wk6UNi2oPABHpTWMHpUf1Xft6KHffW20vZwOW1UDlv5IE4p3ymnh8uxCeZT67qJ7pfAWeB8nufjm12-R4GzLZVdIIFztOV72iuRjHsInORGrlC15ZKfHCnY5O9qL1wvWWgN1nF6y2_hrbK8JQicB9CoAaApxq8nh8CbHkQP72g5_OepPzd4GPwXAAD__0LggV4) as DHS remains partially shut down. ★★★
Daines Stuns with Retirement

Sen. Steve Daines (R-MT) shocked Washington on Wednesday by withdrawing from his reelection bid just minutes before Montana's filing deadline, making him the sixth Republican senator not seeking reelection in 2026. Daines said it's time to ["pass the torch"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkL2uozAQhZ8GOqPB2MAtXGxDl223RAYPyUj-kz2B5O1XyRvc7jTn6Hzfv9t6s-Qp3v_agGY_aXXJrVyeITN6X2PC8E7PggcVdKsEOQoYBOg1-rVvndndOMgWTT9NclJ61HP7MJPeeoAJYJjdsSltNzW5H_UDeLhNzltL5rMEA2jZ96BlBw70OMLspN60Un2j4JmdZazdnmLFclqmEynG9EkpdnsKrTcP5lyb4U8jl0Yu13V1R3pFvD610MglJ09Me23kwimLL5iw3r9FZTxROEsRq8AXcRUhRbbRiorRMopidxTZ21hFQaaCbTEuX-Q91XFqFNyDJf89wr9Xdxr5PwAA__-LqYCy) and endorsed Trump-backed U.S. Attorney Kurt Alme, who filed for the seat moments before the deadline. President Trump immediately endorsed Alme, calling him a ["TRUMP 45 and TRUMP 47"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkLuq5DAQRL9GzjRIrYdnAwWbOJtNNzRad3umQQ8jabzM3198_-AmRUFBHTh_H-sjcuLy_BMzhe3kFSuuo73zMSilXirlT3032rkRrqDAS2WkcmtJq54wbOgNTBT0PMNsnXf36RWc2Y0DHe-79nZH-OWN8bsDu_lIHtXE4XpSRjnQWjm4KVTOe3VHcP-ctVpY9T4wDuq3rZZO7YyDT-JS6tVquW01Tym8xji6ML8FLAIWjJw-W0yJ2rULWC6MgEWZK6yApQ86SWLkQl02Gty4PGWuZcQSZacSB8nMOKjlLmCZWsDjP6fE3c_CqmeOnL7h4-e6zgBfAQAA__92Lnh_) U.S. Attorney. The move adds to a growing wave of GOP retirements that also includes [Sens. McConnell, Tillis, Ernst, and Lummis](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyU0LGO5CAQBNCvwRkjaBvsCwgucTaXXmj1mPYYLTQWYI_271czf7BZSSVVSe__fbljiIGf_zCRW6-w-OyXVs50NIqxcqb0nc9CWyjkF1BgpeqlMgvHRXferd720JHT4wjjYKyZut2NMJDBzSP1G63aTIq2P3oEhUo_aIUuuPeS6pUBrZWBm_LKWKsmD-ZhhkGLQZ2Hx0b1tmauVC5s4aLAnN8p823NqYtub-2oov8rYBYwt532EOO7EzDvORHTqwqYV0wHhicLmM1oJ2OtrI0ukh4DU5VfZ2kSYyKZMjdklJUYG8mPhCT2uVRKxE3A3BXnj1eIMVQ7ikE9E4bPZ9d-L3g5-AkAAP__mayBtA). At least one race analyst shifted the seat from "Safe Republican" to "Lean Republican" within hours. ★★★
House Oversight Subpoenas Bondi

The House Oversight Committee voted 24-19 on Wednesday to subpoena Attorney General Pam Bondi over the DOJ's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files, with five Republicans joining Democrats. Republicans voting for the subpoena blasted Bondi for claiming all files have been released: ["Videos are missing. Audio is missing."](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM2OrCAUhJ8Gd5rDQZANi7tx13c7S4NAd58JP0ZQM28_sd9gNpVKKqkvVV-P5WEpUn79tykYd9Lii1_afqSthRhrLiH9lGMPT9qDXxBQ9SB6kEuOC--8cV4J7ILh04TTKJXU3dto_lROcae1RCW0VU83rU7IVTiwo7YdmbsJBEjkHCQO4EEqBdqjXOU4cjbCsXnbQh1cyTXsp210Bsq53K7kwZXURfNubatM_GM4M5yv6xpcXt0dMpxvBsMZxC2S4Ry22gLl3pfvfi3ZU_9ZOrxbit1u_HZRjFTVxEZ4JUvxQ2l__-U0-BsAAP__B_1wFg) The subpoena calls for closed-door testimony with video to be released publicly. Chairman Comer noted Bondi had offered a private briefing, but the committee wanted answers on the record.

Senate Kills War Powers Resolution

The Senate voted 47-53 on Wednesday to defeat a Democratic war powers resolution on Iran. Sen. Fetterman (D-PA) crossed the aisle to vote no; Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY) was [the sole GOP yes](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyU0DtuwzAQBNDTkJ2M5Yofq2CRRp3TphRocW0R4EcgaQm5feDkBOkGM8Ar5uu23FyIIT8_XSK7HmHxxS-9vtLeKcaWC6Xv8qr0CJX8goB6gHEAteS4CO7t6vWInKwwBo1UWl35ZuXDwbSO3gh916QlTV4CeSWl0pM2Ew_2LcEICoUAhRfwoLSGq0d1V1IKJuG1e9epXdaSG9XD9XBQyLm8U8mXtSQe7db73tj4wXBmOPeNthDje2M4byVRprMxnBtl14nhrIw2V6GGv2I4XR32clJtQ6guM5x5tX4_Q4yhacMkPJMLvyDv_7_nsPgTAAD__4WWczw). The House votes on a similar resolution today.★★★
Record Retirements Hit Congress

A staggering 53 House members have now announced they won't seek reelection in 2026, surpassing the 52 retirements from 2018 and closing in on the all-time record of 65 set in 1992. Republicans make up [32 of the departures](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkL2uozAQhZ8GOqPB2MAtXGxDl223RAYPyUj-kz2B5O1XyRvc7jTn6Hzfv9t6s-Qp3v_agGY_aXXJrVyeITN6X2PC8E7PggcVdKsEOQoYBOg1-rVvndndOMgWTT9NclJ61HP7MJPeeoAJYJjdsSltNzW5H_UDeLhNzltL5rMEA2jZ96BlBw70OMLspN60Un2j4JmdZazdnmLFclqmEynG9EkpdnsKrTcP5lyb4U8jl0Yu13V1R3pFvD610MglJ09Me23kwimLL5iw3r9FZTxROEsRq8AXcRUhRbbRiorRMopidxTZ21hFQaaCbTEuX-Q91XFqFNyDJf89wr9Xdxr5PwAA__-LqYCy), including Rep. Burgess Owens (R-UT), the latest to announce.

★★★
Trump to Endorse in TX Runoff

With Trump announcing he will weigh in on the Cornyn-Paxton runoff "soon," both campaigns are making their case for the endorsement. Paxton's allies believe a [smaller May 26 runoff electorate](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkDGOwyAURE-DO1ufj8FOQbGNu2y7pUXgb4KEAQGxk9uvnBtsM5piNE8zP9f1anzw8f5tNtJ296tLbm3lueVGIdSYaHunZ6FfX8itCKh6ED3INYaVd05bpwR2pPk04TRKJefuoQW3BLObSN4uZDkpJ9RsJprF6KSYbef12QQCJHIOEgdwIJWC2aG8yXHkbIRndqZRHWyKlcpumt_Jx5hOl-Jg09YF_WgtVya-GC4Ml-M4hpyCb96mM8BwiXRUhsuJY7iAOEUyXD4T-2xeLcW-0cvUvlI0jfpc_GbKuweY-Yhw6Yp2-fAh-KomNsJ9Mz588O3_h-0a_wIAAP__tJh4ig) favors the more conservative candidate; Cornyn's team argues their candidate has the money and electability edge.

* * *

DHS Votes Today — Both Chambers

The Senate takes a procedural vote at 1:45 p.m. on the DHS funding bill, which is expected to fail the 60-vote threshold again. The House votes around 4 p.m. on a [nearly identical bill](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyU0L2O4yAUxfGngc7RNTZgFxTbuMu2W1oErsPd4cMy2NG8_Sh5g-n-0pF-xfl3X--WIuXnX5vQuItWX_zajjPtDWOsuWD6LueBGx3oVwFCdTB0INcc155747waBEfTay30KJWceDB-lm52etu8Qz3pxzwDWq1xesjJgd04mbcEA0jR9yDFDTxIpWDyQj7kOPZshHP3tmG9uZIrHpdtdCHlXN5V8s2VxKMJre2VDX-YWJhYWsBAMb43JpZQEmZ81U-eFZlYpFYa9Ngl-sLufwm5ltz5ULvtzJ7yk4mFH8bvL4qRqtJshGey9BF5-_0_lxE_AQAA__8Z43TD). Speaker Johnson called it "shameful" that Democrats would block DHS funding during wartime.★★★
House War Powers Resolution Today

Reps. Massie (R-KY) and Khanna (D-CA) are bringing a war powers resolution to the House floor today. It is [expected to fail](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyU0DtuwzAQBNDTkJ2M5Yofq2CRRp3TphRocW0R4EcgaQm5feDkBOkGM8Ar5uu23FyIIT8_XSK7HmHxxS-9vtLeKcaWC6Xv8qr0CJX8goB6gHEAteS4CO7t6vWInKwwBo1UWl35ZuXDwbSO3gh916QlTV4CeSWl0pM2Ew_2LcEICoUAhRfwoLSGq0d1V1IKJuG1e9epXdaSG9XD9XBQyLm8U8mXtSQe7db73tj4wXBmOPeNthDje2M4byVRprMxnBtl14nhrIw2V6GGv2I4XR32clJtQ6guM5x5tX4_Q4yhacMkPJMLvyDv_7_nsPgTAAD__4WWczw) after the Senate rejected its version 47-53 yesterday. The measure is non-binding and would not require the president's signature.

★★★
Cruz, Scott Push $200B Capital Gains Tax Cut

Sens. Ted Cruz (R-TX) and Tim Scott (R-SC) are urging Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to index capital gains for inflation — a move that would deliver roughly $200 billion in tax relief to Americans selling stocks, homes, and businesses [without needing Congress](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyU0L3uozAQBPCnMR3RsvgjFC6uocu1VyLDboIlY1u2IXdvf0re4N-NNJpfMX8ey8P54OPrtzvYbpdfKNHSynnkxiHUmPj4l87CT1-YFgTUPYw9qCWGZejIbqRH7NgOxqCRSqt7t9uR1ucqJ8k0oWbSyslBwjpNkzMERnXefiQYQeEwgMIbECit4U6oViXlICScmVzjettSrFwu1_zFPsb0SSnetnR0we6t5SrGXwJngXPbefchfDqB854OjvyuAmdHh4--tvLdCpyV0UqD6V8p95Wja6nUPpeUU-W-ub_9djaBc1cs5bcPwVdthITX4fyX79rPz7os_g8AAP__xA95ZA). body:
The Forward Party believes that America can be strong and responsive to world events and national security threats while still faithful to the Constitution. Supporting our troops and defending the rule of law are not competing values. They reinforce each other.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
### Peter —
With Operation Epic Fury, the United States is now engaged in a serious military confrontation with Iran. The situation is dangerous and still unfolding. Six American service members have already been killed, and others wounded. Civilians in the region are also paying a heavy price. First and foremost, we mourn the Americans who have lost their lives in service to this country, and we hold their families in our thoughts. We hope for the speedy recovery of those injured and for the safe return of every American in harm’s way. War also brings suffering to innocent people. Civilians often bear the cost of decisions made far from their homes. Our hearts are with those families as well. Iran’s government has long supported terrorism and destabilized the region. At the same time, the Iranian people themselves have repeatedly shown courage in demanding freedom, dignity, and opportunity. The Forward Party stands with the Iranian people and hopes for a future where they can determine their own destiny free from repression. [](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/blog/official-statement-on-operation-epic-fury/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_92a&n=1) **_Click the image for our official statement on Operation Epic Fury_** But moments like this also raise serious questions about the health of our own democracy and the checks and balances that were installed by the founders. The Constitution is clear. The power to declare war belongs to Congress. The founders put that responsibility in the legislative branch so decisions about war would be debated openly and decided collectively by the representatives of the American people. Over time, that system has eroded. Presidents of both parties have increasingly used military force without clear authorization from Congress. Meanwhile, Congress has too often avoided the responsibility the Constitution assigns to it. When members of Congress fail to debate and vote on war, they are not only avoiding politics; they are avoiding accountability. This is exactly why the War Powers Resolution was passed in 1973. The law was meant to ensure that Congress had a clear role in approving and overseeing military action. Yet again and again, Washington finds ways to sidestep it. The Forward Party believes that America can be strong and responsive to world events and national security threats while still faithful to the Constitution. Supporting our troops and defending the rule of law are not competing values. They reinforce each other. This moment also shows why our political system needs more voices at the table. Today, the two major parties often treat national security debates as partisan battles instead of constitutional responsibilities. Members of Congress frequently line up behind or against a president based on party loyalty rather than institutional duty. That leaves the branch of government responsible for declaring war acting more like a spectator than a decision maker. This is why the Forward Party exists. When independent and third-party lawmakers hold seats in Congress, they can act as a forcing function for accountability. They are less tied to the incentives of the two-party system and more able to insist that Congress actually vote on the most important questions the country faces. War should never be decided by default or drift. It should be decided by debate and by votes. That is what checks and balances are supposed to look like. America is strongest when our institutions work as the Constitution intended. That means a president who leads, a Congress that does its job, and a political system that rewards courage instead of silence. Our troops deserve nothing less. The American people deserve nothing less. And the future of our democracy depends on it. **Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

clean_body: The Forward Party believes that America can be strong and responsive to world events and national security threats while still faithful to the Constitution. Supporting our troops and defending the rule of law are not competing values. They reinforce each other. | | | www.forwardparty.com Peter — With Operation Epic Fury, the United States is now engaged in a serious military confrontation with Iran. The situation is dangerous and still unfolding. Six American service members have already been killed, and others wounded. Civilians in the region are also paying a heavy price. First and foremost, we mourn the Americans who have lost their lives in service to this country, and we hold their families in our thoughts. We hope for the speedy recovery of those injured and for the safe return of every American in harm’s way. War also brings suffering to innocent people. Civilians often bear the cost of decisions made far from their homes. Our hearts are with those families as well. Iran’s government has long supported terrorism and destabilized the region. At the same time, the Iranian people themselves have repeatedly shown courage in demanding freedom, dignity, and opportunity. The Forward Party stands with the Iranian people and hopes for a future where they can determine their own destiny free from repression. Click the image for our official statement on Operation Epic Fury But moments like this also raise serious questions about the health of our own democracy and the checks and balances that were installed by the founders. The Constitution is clear. The power to declare war belongs to Congress. The founders put that responsibility in the legislative branch so decisions about war would be debated openly and decided collectively by the representatives of the American people. Over time, that system has eroded. Presidents of both parties have increasingly used military force without clear authorization from Congress. Meanwhile, Congress has too often avoided the responsibility the Constitution assigns to it. When members of Congress fail to debate and vote on war, they are not only avoiding politics; they are avoiding accountability. This is exactly why the War Powers Resolution was passed in 1973. The law was meant to ensure that Congress had a clear role in approving and overseeing military action. Yet again and again, Washington finds ways to sidestep it. The Forward Party believes that America can be strong and responsive to world events and national security threats while still faithful to the Constitution. Supporting our troops and defending the rule of law are not competing values. They reinforce each other. This moment also shows why our political system needs more voices at the table. Today, the two major parties often treat national security debates as partisan battles instead of constitutional responsibilities. Members of Congress frequently line up behind or against a president based on party loyalty rather than institutional duty. That leaves the branch of government responsible for declaring war acting more like a spectator than a decision maker. This is why the Forward Party exists. When independent and third-party lawmakers hold seats in Congress, they can act as a forcing function for accountability. They are less tied to the incentives of the two-party system and more able to insist that Congress actually vote on the most important questions the country faces. War should never be decided by default or drift. It should be decided by debate and by votes. That is what checks and balances are supposed to look like. America is strongest when our institutions work as the Constitution intended. That means a president who leads, a Congress that does its job, and a political system that rewards courage instead of silence. Our troops deserve nothing less. The American people deserve nothing less. And the future of our democracy depends on it. Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. | | Folks, I’ve been a pioneer for my entire career. I was a year old when the Naval Academy, my eventual alma mater, began admitting women. I was 18 when women were finally allowed to serve on U.S. combatant ships, and I later became one of the first female sailors to spend the entirety of my naval career aboard combatant ships. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126738992/605797411/-507177816?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260305_FR_WomeninUniform_A0_na_U2_X2&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTcwYjYzZC1kYjE4LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HgLYoZ2SwMAdP0RvU2KJ9hbRYPpVz2LQyHU7gF44WAs=) I was one of the first women accepted to the Navy Nuclear Program, and in 2018, I was part of the largest wave of women ever elected to Congress. Being a pioneer is never easy. Ask any woman who’s worked in a STEM field or broken into a male-dominated profession how many times she’s been disrespected, underestimated, and overlooked. I refused to let it break me. I was damn good at my job, and I spent 20 years making history while serving my country. **[I’m preparing to make history again by helping Democrats take back VA-02 and the House majority in November. Will you invest $10 in my campaign so I can once again serve my community and country on Capitol Hill?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126738993/605797412/-507177816?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260305_FR_WomeninUniform_A0_na_U2_X2&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTcwYjYzZC1kYjE4LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HgLYoZ2SwMAdP0RvU2KJ9hbRYPpVz2LQyHU7gF44WAs=)** | | | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126738994/605797413/-507177816?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260305_FR_WomeninUniform_A0_na_U2_X2&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTcwYjYzZC1kYjE4LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HgLYoZ2SwMAdP0RvU2KJ9hbRYPpVz2LQyHU7gF44WAs=)

In Congress, I fought to address the challenges faced by women in the Armed Forces and female veterans. These problems are frequently swept under the rug, but that only made me more determined to make our military safer for women.
That’s what pioneers do: brave hostile terrain to clear a path for those who follow.
Sadly, our current military leaders are reviving the “good old boys” mentality I dealt with 30+ years ago. They’re driving talented women away from service and making us less safe in the process.
My opponent here in VA-02 is also a female veteran, yet she’s done absolutely nothing to stop “anti-woke” culture warriors from harassing _real_ warriors in our Armed Forces.
That's the difference between us. I’m no fair-weather friend, folks. **I’m a fighter to the end.**

subject: my roots run deep
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Haley Stevens for Senate
body:
My family taught me to fight for Maine and its people

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?&t=1&akid=2382%2E49239%2E_yPGmu)
| | |
---
[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/14913?t=2&akid=2382%2E49239%2E_yPGmu)
My roots run deep, null.

My mom’s parents toiled in the fields of Aroostook County, harvesting potatoes with dirt under their fingernails. My dad’s parents come from a long line of granite carvers in Stonington.
My dad served in the U.S. Navy during World War II and taught me the value of hard work from an early age. My mom taught high school English for 35 years and showed me how powerful words are.
Above all else, my family taught me to fight for the great state of Maine and its people. In my years of public service, I have always believed this: that you are our greatest asset.
**[That’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Mainers deserve a leader willing to fight for them no matter what. Split a donation between my campaign and Haley Stevens' campaign now to help me.](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/14914?t=3&akid=2382%2E49239%2E_yPGmu)**
My father always told me, “You’ve got to stand up to bullies. If you don’t, they’ll never stop.”

That’s what I’ve done my whole life and I don’t plan on stopping now.
Thank you,

Janet
|
* * *
**A note from Haley Stevens:** null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. | | |
---
Today, **President Donald Trump** appointed **Oklahoma Senator Markwayne Mullin** to be the new **DHS Secretary** which is a fantastic move. That appointment has now opened up a US Senate seat for the state of Oklahoma and my phone has been blowing from the news media, friends and past campaign supporters asking if I plan on running for that now open seat? A couple quick things: **-1.** This open seat is going to be appointed by Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt. There will be no special election. Also, whoever is appointed to this role cannot run for re-election for the seat once the term is up. **-2.** At this season in my life, I have no intentions of running for any particular office in the near future. I am absolutely loving the opportunity to be the Pastor at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27835117.14396.1.d3eb24100cdd894e95cf543abd211b44). **-3.** If for some reason that I was asked to take the appointment to the open US Senate seat then I am sure the answer would be yes since I already ran for the US Senate in 2022 but would not step away from [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27835117.14397.1.6149f17d4572cc4b1423c7a16b5cd94f) in order to do so. I really do appreciate all the kind words of support. It means a lot! Be sure to check out some upcoming events at Sheridan.Church **Other Upcoming Events At Sheridan** : -Sun, Mar 15 @6:30pm: Tough Q's About Israel w/**Reverend Johnnie Moore** & **Tulsa Jewish Federation**. RSVP for FREE here: [https://jewishtulsa.org/event/moore/](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27835117.14398.1.cfca839ad72201bb0886354bd14f0975) -Wed, April 8 @6:30pm: **Rabbi Jonathan Cahn** -Thur, April 9: **Tim Tebow** -Sun, May 24 @10am: **Pastor Andrew Sedra** -June 19-20: **Remnant Rising w/Eric Trump, General Flynn & many others**... -Oct 8-9: **Flashpoint w/Gene Bailey + others** Please consider giving to the mission of [Sheridan](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27835117.14399.1.19b439501d99f7c68112e01f6ec4de34): [https://sheridan.church/give/](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27835117.14400.1.c72fd898d437b3cfd3e3d0b8c597052a) Thank you, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

I grew up on a Georgia farm. I enlisted in the Marines to serve my country. My wife and I have been married for 35 years -- she became a family doctor while I served, and together we raised five kids and now have four grandkids. After 40 years in uniform -- including leading troops in combat in Afghanistan and retiring as an Army General -- we came home to our farm, grateful and blessed.

As Trump pushes the limits of his power, Mainers don't need a senator who waits to see which way the wind is blowing — they need someone with the backbone to stand up and stop him. That's why it's so telling that when Congress has the chance to rein in Trump's reckless actions, Collins won't say where she stands — because she's always doing the same calculation: count the votes first, then decide how to vote so she can claim independence without ever getting in the way of Trump's agenda. = | = Collins' refusal to stand up to Trump and his disastrous administration has had real consequences for Maine families: Health Care: Collins was a key, pivotal vote to advance the GOP tax bill that will force 61,000 Mainers to lose their health care and shut down rural Maine hospitals in order to pay for tax giveaways to billionaires. Medicaid: She has a decades-long record of voting to cut Medicaid and Medicare and has voted over a dozen times to repeal or undermine the Affordable Care Act. Supporting Dangerous Nominees: Collins has doubled-down and offered "no regrets" on her votes to confirm controversial Trump officials and judicial nominees who are inflicting harm on Mainers, including Brett Kavanaugh, RFK Jr. and OMB Director Russ Vought. body:
The stakes couldn't be higher. At a time of extraordinary attacks on our fundamental right to vote, we have to unite and fight to stop opponents of voting rights in Congress from checking these suppression bills off their to-do list.
RUSH $35 or more right now to block the MEGA Act, defend our right to vote, and stop opponents of voting rights from destroying our democracy >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030526_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
ABC: House Republicans propose stricter voting requirements as Trump administration eyes the midterms [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030526_2&amount=25]
Folks, we've been warning you about the SAVE Act since it was introduced, since it's a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote.
Well, there's a new champion in the " anti-voting legislation " category with the introduction of the Make Elections Great Again (MEGA) Act. The new bill goes far beyond even the SAVE Act, with the MEGA Act now being called " the most extreme voting restrictions ever proposed at the federal level ."
The name also tells you everything you need to know about the target audience for this bill. With Trump focused on re-litigating the 2020 election, this legislation would give him all the power he would need to take federal control of the upcoming midterms .
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE & MEGA ACTS NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030526_2&amount=35]
While the SAVE Act focused almost exclusively on requiring voters to produce documentary proof of citizenship when registering, the MEGA Act is far more sweeping. It would:
* Impose a strict photo ID requirement to vote
* Create a centralized voter surveillance system in every state
* Mandate constant voter roll purges, gutting the “Motor Voter” law that expanded access to voter registration
* Bar states from counting ballots that arrive after Election Day
* Ban universal mail voting, in which states mail a ballot to all registered voters
* Bar the federal funding for voter registration by outside groups
* Unleash lawsuits against election officials
Estimates said the SAVE Act could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities. The MEGA Act would be much, much worse.
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the MEGA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030526_2&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030526_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030526_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030526_2&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030526_2&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030526_2&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030526_2&amount=35]
The scariest parts of the MEGA Act are how it goes after so much more than proof-of-citizenship at registration. States aren't mandated to provide ID to eligible citizens, but the MEGA Act would require citizens to show the right kind of ID every time they went to vote. This creates inequality, like in Texas, where you can vote with a hunting license ( which doesn't require proof of citizenship ) but you can't vote with a college photo ID.
This bill targets voter registration as well, demanding that eligible voters re-prove their citizenship every election, while also requiring states to " take affirmative steps... on an ongoing basis " every 30 days to check and verify their voter rolls. How would they check them? Using a nationwide federal database controlled by MAGA partisans, of course . And the bill calls for all these measures to be in place before we vote in November's general election.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights said about the SAVE Act. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
His words ring even more true about the MEGA Act. This bill is nothing less than an all-out partisan assault on our fundamental right to vote . If made law, this bill would codify MAGA's power for decades to come, invalidating millions of eligible voters and ending our democracy for a generation or longer.
None of us can afford to sit on the sidelines, Team, and watch our fundamental right to vote die. Fight back against these cynical vote suppressors with $35 or whatever you can before it's too late >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030526_2&amount=35]
https://voteractionproject.org/ [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

The measure would ask voters on this November’s ballot to approve a new, temporary congressional map to combat Donald Trump’s redistricting crisis that has had a domino effect nationwide — from Texas to Florida. **This is an urgent and necessary response to the existential threat Republicans pose to our democracy. The measure would ask voters on this November’s ballot to approve a new, temporary congressional map to combat Donald Trump’s redistricting crisis that has had a domino effect nationwide — from Texas to Florida. This is an urgent and necessary response to the existential threat Republicans pose to our democracy. Attorney General Eric Holder puts it into context: | “Republicans have demonstrated that their mid-decade gerrymanders will not end after the 2026 midterms, and in the face of that continued threat, Colorado is taking a responsible step by asking the voters to weigh in on the state’s temporary response. Thanks for standing with us.
— Team JanePAC
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
Hi friends,
Over the weekend, the Trump Administration, along with Israel, launched a major assault on Iran — without debate, without congressional approval, and without any accountability.
Trump ran on false promises to end forever wars, but he addressed the American people from the comfort of Mar-a-Lago this weekend and callously declared _“there will likely be more”_ U.S. troop deaths because _“that’s the way it is.”_ Well, history has shown us exactly where these war drums lead:
It means risking the lives of our service members.
It means putting innocent civilians in Iran, people who have no say in this violence, directly in harm’s way.
It means fueling anti-American sentiment and dragging the United States into yet another forever war.
And it means putting our planet at risk.
Because let’s be honest about what shadows conflicts like this: Iran sits on some of the largest oil reserves in the world. We have seen, time and again, how wars wrapped in the language of “freedom” and “security” are entangled with resource interests. When oil is involved, the line between liberation and exploitation becomes dangerously thin.
Generations of Iranians have waited for this moment. For the regime to fall, for the light of democracy, and the sight of relief to peak through after decades of repression, executions, and stolen futures.
But we have already seen this administration’s disregard for human life at home. And when military strikes hit civilian neighborhoods — including an elementary school for girls — it is painfully clear: this president does not value human life abroad either.
**The American people overwhelmingly oppose a war with Iran. Now Congress must exercise its constitutional authority to immediately stop this illegal war.**
Representatives Thomas Massie and Ro Khanna have already introduced a War Powers Resolution in the House that would require the president to seek explicit approval from Congress for any hostilities towards Iran, and _each and every one of us must call on Congress to pass it without delay._
**[So please: Click here to send a message to Congress and ask your representative to support the War Powers resolution and return oversight authority to Congress. After you send your letter, you’ll be redirected to our call tool so you can follow up with a phone call.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126741145/605804387/1986991988?source=email&refcode=ea.8f8af223-e018-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ms=ea.8f8af223-e018-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhmOGFmMjIzLWUwMTgtZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTFmMGE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=YjzAt2YBa2QShrXgZpGhKQ2xPvEV4VnfmxYqgjbJpNI=&emci=1674611d-e018-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=8f8af223-e018-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=4823105)**
We’ve seen this story before. One lesson should have been enough. No more endless wars.

clean_body: Your name could make a difference. | Friends, The House is set to vote today on the bipartisan War Powers Resolution, and we want to make sure your representative hears from as many people as possible in Cresco before that happens. Every letter we send is a reminder that Trump doesn't get to drag us into yet another costly, forever war without our day — and that Congress has both the power and the responsibility to stop him. | Thanks for standing with us. — Team JanePAC \---------- Forwarded message --------- Hi friends, Over the weekend, the Trump Administration, along with Israel, launched a major assault on Iran — without debate, without congressional approval, and without any accountability. Trump ran on false promises to end forever wars, but he addressed the American people from the comfort of Mar-a-Lago this weekend and callously declared “there will likely be more” U.S. troop deaths because “that’s the way it is.” Well, history has shown us exactly where these war drums lead: It means risking the lives of our service members. It means putting innocent civilians in Iran, people who have no say in this violence, directly in harm’s way. It means fueling anti-American sentiment and dragging the United States into yet another forever war. And it means putting our planet at risk. Because let’s be honest about what shadows conflicts like this: Iran sits on some of the largest oil reserves in the world. We have seen, time and again, how wars wrapped in the language of “freedom” and “security” are entangled with resource interests. When oil is involved, the line between liberation and exploitation becomes dangerously thin. Generations of Iranians have waited for this moment. For the regime to fall, for the light of democracy, and the sight of relief to peak through after decades of repression, executions, and stolen futures. But we have already seen this administration’s disregard for human life at home. And when military strikes hit civilian neighborhoods — including an elementary school for girls — it is painfully clear: this president does not value human life abroad either. The American people overwhelmingly oppose a war with Iran. Now Congress must exercise its constitutional authority to immediately stop this illegal war. Representatives Thomas Massie and Ro Khanna have already introduced a War Powers Resolution in the House that would require the president to seek explicit approval from Congress for any hostilities towards Iran, and each and every one of us must call on Congress to pass it without delay. We’ve seen this story before. One lesson should have been enough. No more endless wars. Hi, it's Michael. I'm writing to catch up with you.

I'm crisscrossing the state to meet with Coloradans and listen to the issues they are facing. It is without a doubt the best part of my job. And if you pitch in $10, it will help me reach a few more Coloradans.

I've held among the most town halls of any senator this year. I recently went out to Durango to meet a packed house of Coloradans and hear their concerns, critiques, and priorities face-to-face. In-person events like this make it clear: People are angry — and rightly so.

Look, the challenges we face are not small: from inaccessible health care, to unaffordable housing, to worse outcomes for their kids in school. As the economy has only grown more unfair with each day since Trump retook office, people feel as if Washington has completely turned its back on them.

But I'm not fazed by these challenges. With supporters like you in my corner, I know we can take them on.

I'm excited to keep meeting with folks across the state on the campaign trail as I work to build the grassroots momentum to compete and win. But it's hard to run a winning campaign without resources — and since I won't accept a cent of corporate PAC money, I'll need your help to reach my $5,000 goal.

subject: Kristi Noem

body:
As governor, I’m fighting every day to hold the Trump administration accountable.
#
Peter,
**Donald Trump just fired Department of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem.**
This is after months of her overseeing the federal occupation of Minnesota and cities across America.
Kristi Noem has done a stunning amount of damage to our state and country. It’s good she’s gone.
To Minnesotans: Thank you for continuing to speak out and organize peacefully. Your public pressure helped make this happen. I won’t pretend her departure fixes everything, but _accountability matters_.
**Now, we have to focus on justice.** That means a complete overhaul of DHS, impartial investigations into the killings of two American citizens, and information on children that were taken from Minnesota.
As governor, I’m fighting every day to hold the Trump administration accountable.
This fight isn’t over, but I couldn’t be prouder of Minnesotans than I am right now.
More soon,
Tim
While Kristi Noem is gone, Tim Walz still needs our help fighting for Minnesotans’ rights in the courts.

body:
Lent Is a Wake-Up Call for Us All
This Lent, your faith can help protect the innocent.

| | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=361772d3c686477da29735f0e196d4a9&_e=5m9lHPOmAcidv-XlYlpZ_1ZRj5Uk1-y5BlxpINnn_svHs8_GctYfBv95bveUz1H3DZ4CcIcHAW8KbesHw_Z6o1cHB5xS3aQ3y9astQoq0c0GKCrth10jfnoKxIcIWS_J5t3IstsYBm46sHte27Vfhs2HzQsoVSgw4ui79nX5dfD8VpWFvEvtRhKsUU5oAD5xYGESfD0LhfTY7kMWySwl8FfxIg3eYwn9_TpLRYn5ICe2AVnwZ-cEJk_NDMRzX9SBI9d4KvYS-KyXLADwB8_Oz0wAVw9g22rpKEur8BCwRWUnPqvDi4OqJ4rgqI7Ivtz1aTKPHsL3F1Oq-1EfhmIbXMBxrUhuNeZKGlT6ejE3vDn3P79m8yOJF_pg5OAVEVqg8McccN6CEbhe7yhQLGbyQKQIWpnbZyjvAJuey1nlD4Ee4D7CsNQj5al2G8Mvl9zQ4Ow0-eAKJpMJs4VhCR4NwJvv98IABudpyW-t7aCne0RfILTewN_T8EIatm44vVDDlbyrFos1SZ-xFxzXkR3hHYoLCdDzUaXOkS5hdOVjwEN6EslGG5txGq41_odk6k0ZPoz1lHPP9MlqjOuFkB1cNUKIWNXs2XJ-CzgTV-8yDELJlbCEVvLD5GvxUkkjMCElbQc-Sm3LFM7Y0qqmW0UGu1x052Bru9wfkUMxD03h-FJ29kDoWAPd5Kf805otqTQ8_5tsHc3rlchDT8cdQyB2rFtPLwKTYD5hIvXM1uhzwh3r8CgxlhcqMVO54EE3r8qi0_ZvJBRem8qSuJdf-TkfNQ%3D%3D)
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,
---
Lent is not just a season.It is a pilgrimage.A journey led by the Holy Spirit... into the desert.**And the desert is not empty.**
**It is sacred.**
**It is where God reminds us who we are.** When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested.
---
[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=361772d3c686477da29735f0e196d4a9&_e=5m9lHPOmAcidv-XlYlpZ_1ZRj5Uk1-y5BlxpINnn_svHs8_GctYfBv95bveUz1H3DZ4CcIcHAW8KbesHw_Z6o1cHB5xS3aQ3y9astQoq0c0GKCrth10jfnoKxIcIWS_J5t3IstsYBm46sHte27Vfhs2HzQsoVSgw4ui79nX5dfD8VpWFvEvtRhKsUU5oAD5xYGESfD0LhfTY7kMWySwl8FfxIg3eYwn9_TpLRYn5ICe2AVnwZ-cEJk_NDMRzX9SBI9d4KvYS-KyXLADwB8_OzyQBxjT9GF7GrgE_WomeYWtf9wPgKECnY3ImuerXAOn5OZ6QkGU2Ci1rmlVwCKohyJaiBlFjaozCuJYuc8iN9PG76BYKCuPYRWgSnYC8oqxxCBvrjqqR_y45k92hQ1R4kzVbKQo8nu9LFggOnJi7Nx4GRggt-s18rQS0zh2mBOM3Y42rVvfmIOFYBCI0_B9IUyzw3G3O2SSR8KZ_yMa_7EylZJom8AH7gsudPgiKWm2AU4RP5rIxgkPp04I9Ph0plktuxEMK6YNiZWJTuPrkluBwCJPn6RbJ9yAuvKvKDoYDyXYR38RRS5HzuDlICEoVUOZpnuRsIsuYVhGkoQxFO-QiFOLVGZpBWNyS0JMiHWGDkM2TnQ0hjynyFG3308wbIppV9xNn92XbnI-Mr0ViEff0dvZtxrqbZGL90RCmkryVaymKQl5dS8UDNxzGQvFVEcMvDVHZRYaP31EDfM_Darox5rr5SERgOvmYmaAIGp3ndiy2LZH1dTtDXPi5xYVNhA%3D%3D)
---
But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: **_" You are my beloved Son."_**That same Father speaks over you.**You are His beloved son.**
**His beloved daughter.** Before any label.
Before any denomination.And so is every child.Even the child who has been lured... kidnapped... sold.
---
You may not know me yet.My name is Eduardo Verastegui.I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking.**What I heard broke my heart.** Children treated like products.
Like profit.
Like they do not matter.I asked myself,_" What if it were my child?"_That question changed my life. The film became a movement.
And the **Sound of Freedom Foundation was born.** But the story did not end when the credits rolled. Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins.We **equip **trusted partners who rescue children.
We **educate **families so they can protect their sons and daughters.
We **advocate** for laws that defend the innocent.This is not politics.
It is protection.

Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? You can make a difference by splitting a donation between our campaign for NY-12 and Outrage then Action PAC today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=022626_1]

# Trump axes Kristi Noem, appoints MMA Warrior Sen. Markwayne Mullin as DHS Chief
President Donald Trump fired Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem on Thursday amid mounting criticism of her immigration crackdown leadership and **[named Oklahoma Sen. Markwayne Mullin,](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca01f1c-2d75-4b23-9bc3-a1637e2d8345?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a staunch ally and former MMA fighter, as her replacement effective March 31.

* **Trump Praise Details:** Trump hailed Mullin on Truth Social for border security migrant crime combat and drug scourge ending calling him highly respected with strong people skills and policy alignment.
* **Mullin Political Edge:** Known as Senate whisperer Mullin aided Trump's reelection via indigenous outreach faced ethics repayment and fiery hearings including challenging foes to fights and clashing with Bernie Sanders.

# Nancy Mace livid as Congress kills own misconduct transparency push
The House overwhelmingly voted 357-65 on March 5, 2026, to bury Rep. Nancy Mace's resolution **[forcing public release of sexual misconduct investigation records,](https://substack.com/redirect/ebecccd1-7857-49e8-a86b-58b3379cad67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with bipartisan leadership blocking transparency on Capitol Hill scandals.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7ec609cb-b01c-4a9a-8892-3473e179a080?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Bipartisan Protection Exposed** : Leadership from both parties whipped votes to refer Mace's resolution to the Ethics Committee, ensuring it dies without advancing to public disclosure.
* **Resolution 's Core Demand** : It mandated preserving and releasing Ethics Committee records on sexual harassment or staff relationships, redacting victim identities but exposing evidence, reports, and conclusions.
* **Mace 's Fierce Rebuke** : She accused colleagues of shielding predators, stating voters deserve accountability while Congress hides behind a broken, secretive process that protects itself over victims.
* **Broader Scandal Context** : Push highlighted amid cases like Rep. Tony Gonzales' prohibited staff relationship, which ended tragically, underscoring institutional secrecy and power imbalances in Congress.

# **Jeffrey Epstein quietly invested in Manhattan luxury condo building that drew Chelsea Clinton, Jennifer Lopez**
Newly released Epstein files reveal the convicted pedophile **[quietly backed the luxury conversion of 21 E. 26th St. in NoMad](https://substack.com/redirect/bdaafd6a-53f4-4b69-9ede-d35e00fe87e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --later marketed as the Whitman--committing roughly $920,000 through a stake in the project's sponsor entity and a smaller limited-partner investment that gave him access to profits typically reserved for developers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bdaafd6a-53f4-4b69-9ede-d35e00fe87e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Developer David Mitchell offered Epstein unusually favorable terms in 2011, allowing him to buy a 30% stake in the development entity AdvanceStar for $700,000 and invest another $220,000 as a limited partner. Epstein moved quickly with "no due diligence," writing to Mitchell "I am merely relying on your representations," and even floated taking the building's duplex penthouse instead of a profit payout, writing "i would like to do a similar soho house type deal, take the penthouse instead of profit."
* **The buyers:** The five-story building was transformed into four full-floor residences and a duplex penthouse, attracting celebrity buyers including NASCAR champion Jeff Gordon (who bought the second floor for $10 million in 2013 and sold for $13.5 million in 2023), Chelsea Clinton and husband Marc Mezvinsky (who purchased a full-floor "luxury fortress" for $9.25 million in 2013 that they still own), and Jennifer Lopez (who bought the duplex penthouse Epstein eyed for nearly $20 million in 2014 and sold for $23 million in 2024). Internal projections showed Epstein's investment could return more than $1.6 million--an almost 80% return.

* * *
# Jemele Hill mocks midwest border fears
Atlantic contributing writer Jemele Hill sparked backlash Wednesday by dismissing border security concerns from Midwestern voters as racist, **[accusing them of fearing a"too brown" America](https://substack.com/redirect/0b14dd1d-bd0b-4cfa-84e1-256a86ca57c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while mocking their inland locations far from any border.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9478da35-c1fd-4283-8fbb-9bb4fb632dae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Racial Motivation Claimed :** Hill asserted many voters backed strict immigration policies to prevent the U.S. from becoming "a little too brown, little too dark," demanding they admit racial bias drives their stance.
* **Geographic Dismissal Highlighted :** She ridiculed residents of Iowa, Nebraska, and even Connecticut for worrying about border "invasion," noting their states lack proximity to international borders or even Canada.
* **Midwest Enforcement Examples :** Recent ICE actions in mocked states included arresting an armed illegal immigrant school superintendent in Iowa and detaining dozens with criminal records at a Nebraska food plant.
* **Broader Context Noted :** Hill's comments on her "SPOLITICS Live" show follow Trump's 2024 win on mass deportations amid record migration under Biden, amplifying debates over immigration motivations.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Texas voters sent out a message that’s loud and clear:
body:
Texans are done with leaders who don’t work for them.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Democrats showed up in record-breaking numbers for the primary, Peter.
**In fact,_Democrats outvoted Republicans_ in a midterm primary in a twenty-point swing from 2024.**
Democratic turnout in the Texas primary surged to record levels, with _2.3 million votes_ tallied. **Just to put this into perspective, that’s the highest turnout in a midterm primary for Democrats since 1970, and is the second highest since the 2008 presidential race.**
Texas voters sent a message that was loud and clear:
We're done with Republican leadership, and we're ready to elect new leaders who are going to work for us — _not against us._
Momentum is real. But it’s not going to carry itself to the finish line; we need to work together to get there.
Over the next eight months, I have work to do across the entire state. I need to show up in communities big and small, meet countless Texans and hear about the issues they are facing, and share a clear vision for a Texas that works for working families, not special interests. And that takes resources. We have a real shot at winning in November, but only if we show up, listen, and earn trust in every single community.

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. | Hello Forward Friends- Can you believe spring is already here? The time is flying and hopefully everyone is busy doing fun community activities. Now through August, I am going to send this newsletter only once a month. In September when our GOTV efforts really ramp up, I will increase newsletter frequency back to biweekly so you know what candidates we are supporting and how you can help. In the meantime, we are heavily focused and finding success with [recruiting](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=WArSXe-hufzYEjhaXmZeHZsqV1jAPxVq4EQJo-ADaJHnoTT71kLKGj1HZsFEpcRbPfi4hPfpMcLoFy-9uzBMd9xguET59RWfBqySe8hfw5t3o6v4k9UrRmgZzjR3OFub1PVptYrpyJZa3LFBmPntNQ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_march_one&n=2) new supporters and building new state parties! Congratulations to **Washington** , **Alabama** , and **Missouri** for getting a leadership team together to kick things off in a big way! If you are in any of these states and would like to get involved, please respond to this email. _Volunteer Spotlight:_ Our volunteer of the month for March is **Prakesh Bhave!** Prakesh is in NC and has done an incredible job helping gather signatures for ballot access. When asked why he volunteers, Prakesh says, "I volunteer with the Forward Party in hopes that, by the time my kids get to be my age, they can enjoy life in a thriving democracy that is not encumbered by our gridlocked, political duopoly." We appreciate you stepping up and dedicating your time to this movement! Prakesh was nominated by another NC volunteer. subject: I come from generations of Pueblo women
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
[photos enclosed]

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=2&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
Friend, I grew up in a military family, so we moved around a lot. But no matter where we lived, we were always outdoors, running through the desert with my cousins, fishing with my dad, or walking the cornfields with my grandfather. Back then, I never imagined that those moments would shape my path, **[let alone lead me to run for governor of New Mexico.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=3&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=4&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
From my great-grandmother, mother, and many before them, I’m blessed to come from generations of Pueblo women who taught me what it means to be fierce and resilient — and I’ve carried these values with me my entire life.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=5&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
My parents didn’t graduate from college, but they believed deeply in giving back and helping others. They taught me that where you come from matters and that service is about showing up for people. It’s why I tell kids not to forget their roots and why I believe everyone, no matter their background, has something to offer their community.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=6&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
I carried those values when I started working at my local bakery right after high school; when I volunteered at my child’s preschool to help reduce the cost of tuition; and when I started my own small business producing and canning homemade salsa.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=7&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
I carried them with me when I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on food stamps and WIC to help keep my child fed and healthy.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=8&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
And I carried those values with me as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then as the first Native Secretary of the Interior.

**To this day, those values of ferocity and resilience _[fuel my fight to advocate for working families and deliver progress for all New Mexicans.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=9&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)_**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=10&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
But here’s the thing: **The governor’s seat has a history of switching parties every eight years, and GOP donors are already preparing to spend millions to defeat me. If we're going to buck the trend, I need you on my grassroots team, friend.**
**_[So please, will you contribute $5 or more today to help me become our next governor and create a better future for all New Mexicans?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=11&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk291-fr-nd&amount=5&t=12&akid=7931%2E400544%2E7KHMnG)
---
Be fierce,

Deb

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Why I’m running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Roy Cooper for North Carolina
body:
If you want to make a difference, you don’t wait for an invitation.
| | | | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6757?t=6&akid=697%2E124072%2ECTRYT9)
Peter, I’m humbled and excited to be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in North Carolina.

I was raised in Nash County, working on the farm in the summers. My mom was a public school teacher, and she taught me that if you want to make a difference, you don’t wait for an invitation. You step up and do the work.
That’s what I fought to do as Governor, and it’s why I'm running for Senate. Working families in North Carolina deserve a fighter, but right now, the Washington DC insiders are trying to buy this seat for one of their own.

My GOP opponent, Michael Whatley, was handpicked by Donald Trump. He’s spent his career promoting the billionaires who want to gut our health care and put Social Security on the chopping block just to give themselves a tax break.
The polls show we are neck-and-neck, and the national GOP is funneling nearly half a billion dollars into North Carolina to buy this seat. They know that if they can win here, Democrats will lose our shot at taking back the Senate.
**That’s why we’ve set a goal to raise $1 million before tonight at midnight to kick off this general election campaign. That’s what we need to start this race – Democrats’ best shot at flipping a Senate seat – on the right foot, and I am personally asking you to help us get there.**
**_[Will you make your first donation right now to help me win in North Carolina, break the GOP’s hold on Washington, D.C. and return power to the people?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6757?t=7&akid=697%2E124072%2ECTRYT9)_**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6757?t=8&akid=697%2E124072%2ECTRYT9)
---
Thank you,

Roy
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**[Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6533?source=&t=1&akid=697%2E124072%2ECTRYT9)**

Folks,
One doctor for every 486 people.
That’s the reality for folks in rural Colorado [https://www.gjsentinel.com/news/western_colorado/a-look-at-cus-pipeline-for-rural-doctors/article_ea5706d7-c29f-40a0-af7f-ab93c51a2a18.html] compared to urban regions that have one doctor per 325 people.
That's why when a rural hospital closes, or a family physician leaves town, it has a life-or-death impact. It means we have to drive hours longer for basic care. Or get delayed diagnoses from skipping annual visits. And too often, families are forced to choose between refilling their prescription medicine and putting food on the table because they can’t afford the skyrocketing cost of healthcare.
Now that Trump has turned on him, Hurd wants to act like it was all because he really cares about us. Colorado voters aren’t buying it, and neither are we.
And now that Medicaid — a lifeline for rural communities — is under attack in Washington, rural communities across CO-03 have never been more vulnerable.
Medicaid is a promise to provide affordable, high-quality healthcare to everyone, regardless of income. Rural hospitals are a lifeline to small Mountain towns and underserved rural areas. If elected to Congress, I’ll fight to keep both.
This isn’t a partisan issue, it’s a personal one. If you believe rural communities deserve better, will you contribute to help us flip this seat blue and protect Medicaid? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-ak?&]

There is a way to shut down authoritarianism. Join us this Sunday.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260305-5975-footer&t=1&akid=5975%2E420207%2EVH5bUJ)
Peter,
On top of his illegal war in Iran, Donald Trump announced this week he’s replacing Kristi Noem as DHS Secretary. But let’s be honest — whoever he installs won’t be any better. They will still be tasked with carrying out Trump’s authoritarian agenda and unleashing masked immigration agents to terrorize communities and families across the country.
There’s something else this moment shows us: the fact that Trump felt enough pressure to fire Noem in the first place proves that our resistance _is_ working. When people speak out, organize, and refuse to stay silent, it shakes the foundations of authoritarianism. It’s critical that we continue standing up in nonviolent resistance and making our voices heard.
**That’s why I’m asking you to join the Resistance Lab: Boycott the Billionaires this Sunday, March 8th, at 11 am PT / 2 pm ET.** [**You can RSVP using this link!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52450?utm_source=em20260305-5975&t=2&akid=5975%2E420207%2EVH5bUJ)
[****](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52450?utm_source=em20260305-5975&t=3&akid=5975%2E420207%2EVH5bUJ)
During this session, we will drive into the strategies of **boycotts and strikes.**
By joining us on Sunday, you will:
✅ Gain frameworks for understanding the current political moment
✅ Deepen your understanding of economic strikes and boycotts as a tool to shut down authoritarianism
✅ Foster connection, strengthen local networks, and build genuine collective power
This Resistance Lab is for everyone, whether you’ve been with us from the start or you’re newly empowered to take action.
**If you’re ready to take back our power, I hope you’ll join us on March 8 at 11 am PT / 2 pm ET.**[**RSVP now to save your spot!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52450?utm_source=em20260305-5975&t=4&akid=5975%2E420207%2EVH5bUJ)

— Pramila Jayapal

body:
It's bad, folks
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260305-2581)
Peter,
Gas prices hit $2.94 a gallon yesterday, up 40 cents in seven days. Iran has now closed the Strait of Hormuz, the crucial chokepoint through which a fifth of the world's oil supply passes.
This war is costing American taxpayers $687 every second, according to the National Priorities Project. Every second. While you’re reading this email, the bill is growing.
This will get worse. And while Wisconsin families are stretching a tank of gas, there are people betting on war.
On an online prediction market called Polymarket, traders made $1.2 million correctly betting on the exact date the U.S. would strike Iran — hours before it happened. Another pocketed $553,000 betting Iran's supreme leader would be killed — just before he was.
Polymarket runs on cryptocurrency — nobody has to say who they are. So we don't know who placed those bets. We may never know.
And while that was happening, over 200 U.S. service members from across every branch of the military filed complaints with a watchdog organization saying their commanders were telling them this war is — and I am not making this up — "all part of God's divine plan," and that Trump was "anointed by Jesus to light the signal fire in Iran to cause Armageddon."
I'm a candidate for governor. I can't vote to end this war. But I can tell you what it's costing Wisconsin families — and who's cashing in while we pay.
I'm running for governor because Wisconsin families deserve a fighter in the Capitol — someone who will push for universal childcare, a BadgerCare public option, fully funded schools, and real relief from the cost of living that keeps climbing while the powerful look out for themselves.
**[The bets are placed. The bombs are falling. The gas prices are climbing. The only thing that changes any of it is power — and that's what we're building. Chip in today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260305.4kDUFM&refcode=em20260305-2581&t=1&akid=2581%2E105371%2Eg9b48G)**

name: Squad Victory Fund
subject: Noem got the boot →
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260305-2001-foote&t=1001&akid=2001%2E342411%2Ev6l9-P ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter, Kristi Noem
was fired today as Secretary of Homeland Security.

This didn’t just happen on its own. It’s the result of relentless
organizing and grassroots pressure from people in Minnesota and across the
country who refused to stay silent about ICE and DHS abuses.

But the system that enabled this violence is still in place — and unless
we keep fighting, more families will continue to pay the price.

This week, Noem faced hours of questioning in the Senate about deadly
immigration enforcement operations and the tactics used by federal
immigration agents. Her testimony came after two devastating deaths in
Minneapolis: Renee Good and Alex Pretti, both brutally murdered during
encounters with these agents.

Instead of taking responsibility, Noem tried to hide behind
technicalities. She argued that she had described the events as “domestic
terrorism,” not the individuals involved. And when asked if immigration
agents might show up at polling places this November, she wouldn’t rule it
out.

This is exactly why so many communities live in fear every day. ICE
continues to operate with violence and impunity — and when lives are
destroyed, the government too often closes ranks instead of telling the
truth.

The Squad Victory Fund is standing with the families demanding justice and
fighting for bold structural change, including abolishing ICE and stopping
this violence from spreading further into our communities.

And the same grassroots pressure that forced accountability this week is
how we win bigger change.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/noem-fired-abolish-ice/?source=em20260305-2001&t=1002&akid=2001%2E342411%2Ev6l9-P ]Will you sign our petition today and stand with the people fighting
back against this terror? Our communities deserve justice, and our
families deserve safety.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/noem-fired-abolish-ice/?source=em20260305-2001&t=1003&akid=2001%2E342411%2Ev6l9-P ]ADD YOUR NAME

The Squad Victory Fund

Firing Kristi Noem isn’t justice

| |
---
Friend, Kristi Noem has been fired as Secretary of Homeland Security. But that hardly fixes the problem. For months, I’ve been warning about what ICE and DHS are doing in our communities. Masked agents show up in neighborhoods, refusing to identify themselves and acting as if the rules don’t apply to them. That's not American. We saw the consequences in Minnesota. Federal agents with little training flooded the state and wreaked havoc on communities, harassing the people of Minneapolis, and murdered two innocent Americans. Noem not only defended the agents involved but also labeled the victims as domestic terrorists. I went to Minnesota after these shootings and saw the aftermath for myself. That’s the operation Kristi Noem oversaw. But this goes beyond one person. That’s the climate this administration has created. Through four combat tours in Iraq, I was held responsible for everything my platoon did or failed to do. DHS should be held to that same level of accountability. **[ICE must be abolished.
