| | Here they go again. Extremist lawmakers in Georgia are trying to pass another anti-voter bill — but we’re fighting back alongside allies, and [**we’re asking you to help stop legislation like this as we face a significant deadline in one day.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126745458/605818524/-748031486?refcode=emm_ffa_20260305_T1_SB568_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTAyNjExOC1lZTE4LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=41EkP4cRvkz7XewkA71twdfOGQQZU_HoV7smCW1LdqQ=) SB 568 would **strip away countywide early voting** and force voters into a single assigned site. That means **longer lines, more confusion, and another unfunded overhaul** — just months before the pivotal midterms — possibly in an effort to strain our local elections system. Early voting is by far the most popular method of casting a ballot here in Georgia, across both parties. A dramatic change like SB 568 would require a full overhaul of voter education, election administration, and voters’ plans to vote. But we still have time to stop the bill from becoming law. Friday, March 6 is “Crossover Day” for the Georgia General Assembly. That’s the deadline for a piece of legislation to pass either the House or Senate so it can “cross over” and be considered by the other chamber before the end of the legislative session. In other words: if we can stop SB 568 from passing the Senate by tomorrow, we might be able to prevent it from coming up again this election year. **With support from activists like you, we’re getting Early voting is by far the most popular method of casting a ballot here in Georgia, across both parties. A dramatic change like SB 568 would require a full overhaul of voter education, election administration, and voters’ plans to vote. But we still have time to stop the bill from becoming law. Friday, March 6 is “Crossover Day” for the Georgia General Assembly. That’s the deadline for a piece of legislation to pass either the House or Senate so it can “cross over” and be considered by the other chamber before the end of the legislative session. Lent is not just a season.It is a pilgrimage.A journey led by the Holy Spirit... into the desert.**And the desert is not empty.**
**It is sacred.**
**It is where God reminds us who we are.** When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested.

But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: **_" You are my beloved Son."_**That same Father speaks over you.**You are His beloved son.**
**His beloved daughter.** Before any label.
Before any denomination.And so is every child.Even the child who has been lured... kidnapped... sold.
---
You may not know me yet.My name is Eduardo Verastegui.I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking.**What I heard broke my heart.** Children treated like products.
Like profit.
Like they do not matter.I asked myself,_" What if it were my child?"_That question changed my life. The film became a movement.
And the **Sound of Freedom Foundation was born.** But the story did not end when the credits rolled. Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins.We **equip **trusted partners who rescue children.
We **educate **families so they can protect their sons and daughters.
We **advocate** for laws that defend the innocent.This is not politics.
It is protection.
**It is faith in action.**

But if we are honest...Our hearts can grow numb and we get distracted. We get comfortable.**Lent is a wake-up call.** A time for metanoia.
A turning back to God.This Lenten season, pause and ask the Holy Spirit: "What do **You** want to restore in me?"Your prayer life?
Your courage?
Your tenderness toward the vulnerable?Because when hearts grow cold...children suffer.And today, many of God's children are enslaved.**They are created in His image.**
**They belong to Him.**
**Their dignity is sacred.** When we forget that... the innocent pay the price.

I ask **Saint Michael** to defend them.Not instead of God.But asking them to pray with us... **as one family in Christ.**

clean_body: Lent Is a Wake-Up Call for Us All This Lent, your faith can help protect the innocent. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Peter, Lent is not just a season.It is a pilgrimage.A journey led by the Holy Spirit... into the desert.And the desert is not empty. It is sacred. It is where God reminds us who we are. When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested. But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: " You are my beloved Son."That same Father speaks over you.You are His beloved son. His beloved daughter. Before any label. Before any denomination.And so is every child.Even the child who has been lured... kidnapped... sold. You may not know me yet.My name is Eduardo Verastegui.I produced the film Sound of Freedom after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking.What I heard broke my heart. Children treated like products. Like profit. Like they do not matter.I asked myself," What if it were my child?"That question changed my life. The film became a movement. And the Sound of Freedom Foundation was born. But the story did not end when the credits rolled. Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins.We equip trusted partners who rescue children. We educate families so they can protect their sons and daughters. We advocate for laws that defend the innocent.This is not politics. It is protection. It is faith in action. But if we are honest...Our hearts can grow numb and we get distracted. We get comfortable.Lent is a wake-up call. A time for metanoia. A turning back to God.This Lenten season, pause and ask the Holy Spirit: "What do You want to restore in me?"Your prayer life? Your courage? Your tenderness toward the vulnerable?Because when hearts grow cold...children suffer.And today, many of God's children are enslaved.They are created in His image. They belong to Him. Their dignity is sacred. When we forget that... the innocent pay the price. During Lent, I pray more intentionally.I ask the Holy Spirit to strengthen us for this battle. As a Catholic, I also ask for the prayers of the faithful who have gone before us.I ask Our Lady of Guadalupe to intercede for these little ones. I ask Saint Joseph to guard them. I ask Saint Michael to defend them.Not instead of God.But asking them to pray with us... as one family in Christ. Because this is spiritual warfare.Light against darkness. And Jesus was clear:" Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me." (Matthew 25:40)When we protect a child, we serve Christ. When we rescue the vulnerable, we love Christ. Peter, you may be hearing about this mission for the first time.But maybe this is not an accident.Maybe the Holy Spirit is inviting you into something deeper this Lent. Let Him restore your heart. And together, let us restore freedom to enslaved children of God.This is not about one church. It is about the Gospel.It is about the truth that every human life has dignity because it comes from God. So we say it boldly:God 's children are not for sale.Not in our nation. Not in our world. Not ever.Will you stand with us? With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Trump is trying to pack our courts with yet another extremist nightmare:
Anna St. John — a corporate favorite masquerading as a “justice seeker.”
Trust us, she isn’t on your side.

St. John has spent her career helping corporations dodge accountability
while trampling protections for consumers, people of color, LGBTQ+
communities, and survivors of sexual assault. She argued to end
affirmative action and called diversity and inclusion programs
“discriminatory.”

Really.

When survivors of sexual harassment and assault have sought justice, St.
John has defended forced arbitration — a tool she calls “legitimate” that
keeps victims from ever seeing the inside of a courtroom.

Meanwhile, the powerful keep getting a free pass. And now she wants the
lifetime authority of a federal judge.

If confirmed, St. John would have the ability to shape our courts for
decades — making it near impossible to hold corporations accountable,
defend civil rights, and protect survivors of abuse.

We can’t let another one of Trump’s dangerous nominees slide through.
